x: one shared fixed-H2 warm-start trajectory plus actual newly launched executor trajectories

shared_h2_warm_start_provenance.semantics: one fixed-harness/base-executor pre-adaptation trajectory shared as a best-so-far reference; every arm starts its fresh campaign from task.initial_program and does not inherit this discovered program

protocol_validity_guards.eplb: output-level replica-count and logical-group-to-node topology; rejects global packing that ignores num_groups/num_nodes
protocol_validity_guards.prism: success_rate must equal 1.0 across all generated placement cases; partial-success cherry-picking is invalid
protocol_validity_guards.application: online in _eval_worker for new context/executor arms and hash-indexed post-hoc replay through the same checks for legacy proposer summaries

executor_baseline.name: budget-scaled TTT-Discover-style executor adaptation
executor_baseline.x_accounting: actual launched trajectories, including failed/straggling launches; AHC039 supplemental launches are counted from per-trajectory logs

training.scheduler_note: the local FSDP cosine scheduler initializes at lr=0; GBS=4 gives a K=8 replay two optimizer boundaries so the first updates Adam moments but not weights and the second makes a non-zero weight update, without replaying data

executor_baseline.budget_deviation: 8 trajectories in one group per update; official default is 8 groups x 64
implementation_deviations: local FSDP replay trains a teacher-forced final edit/program rather than the official Tinker stack's complete sampled token trajectory
local Adam uses beta2=0.98 and weight decay=0.1; official Adam uses beta2=0.95 and does not report weight decay
local jobs preserve LoRA weights but restart Adam state at each update; the official training client is persistent
local K=8 uses two GBS=4 optimizer boundaries as a scheduler workaround; official TTT-Discover takes one optimizer step on the full 512-rollout batch

official_sources.official_optimizer: Adam lr=4e-5 (AHC058: 2e-5), beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95, eps=1e-8; one full-batch step
official_sources.official_compute_accounting: the paper labels 25,600 rollouts as sampling-budget matched and explicitly treats training updates as additional compute; it reports a separate cost-matched Best-of-N analysis

common_start.warm_start_measurement: one fixed-H2/base-executor trajectory with 20 evaluator calls, displayed at x=1 for every arm
common_start.actual_program_start: task.initial_program for the first fresh batch of every arm; later batches follow only that arm's task-local ratchet
common_start.executor_puct_root: task.initial_program with its true seed score; the H2 warm-start score is not assigned to that program
common_start.proposer_context_first_fresh_batch_x: 1 + actual materialized executor launches; invalid H1 proposals are charged separately as proposer calls
common_start.cost_treatment: the identical warm-start is reported separately; logical per-arm adaptation costs exclude it

comparison_policy.efficiency_series: historical task-local proposer-weight campaigns vs. newly isolated context and executor arms
comparison_policy.proposer_context_feedback_matching: both H1 routes receive the task-local incumbent and the same bounded per-candidate scored-feedback format; context alone adds two frozen-model analyst calls, while proposer alone updates proposer weights
comparison_policy.x_scope: task-local launched executor trajectories only; proposer generation, analyzer inference, LoRA training, and checkpoint merge are not converted into rollout equivalents
comparison_policy.total_compute_status: x supports executor-sample-efficiency comparisons, not equal-total-GPU-compute claims; job-level GPU time is audited separately
comparison_policy.causal_scope: this is a comparison of complete reward-routing systems, not a pure optimizer-target intervention: after the shared fixed-H2 anchor, proposer/context synthesize candidate harnesses through H1 while the TTT-style executor reference keeps the initial harness fixed
comparison_policy.ceiling_context: historical proposer-weight rounds are aggregated across prior campaigns; the local-ledger curve is the proposer arm in the five-task common-budget audit, but it is not an independent rerun contemporaneous with the new arms
comparison_policy.sampling_uncertainty: historical proposer and newly run context/executor campaigns use unpaired sampling seeds; there is one campaign per arm and no confidence interval
comparison_policy.proposer_restart_accounting: the historical AHC039 proposer curve aggregates several task-local restarts; every launched trajectory is charged, but it is not one uninterrupted optimizer lineage
comparison_policy.model_call_accounting: trajectory ledgers recover request counts but local vLLM does not report complete per-request token totals; request-budget results are a sensitivity analysis, not FLOP equivalence
comparison_policy.main_table_alignment: shared fixed-H2 warm-start scores and blue inset endpoints use the main-table provenance; H2 is a measured harness baseline, not an inherited task program. The AHC039 table endpoint is not assigned an x coordinate because its separate team run has no local rollout ledger
comparison_policy.sql_proposer_leak_policy: historical round471--475 is excluded because its serialized H1 prompt contained a curated note naming a 0.728 program and asking for verbatim adoption; the plotted/main-table SQL endpoint must come from outer-proposer-sota5-sql-clean-v1, whose prompts and task-local incumbent chain are audited fail-closed

historical_matched_arm_ratchet_direction.impact: the shared proposer/context A/B driver selected its next incumbent with the wrong direction even though evaluator combined_score is higher-is-better
historical_matched_arm_ratchet_direction.treatment: points are shown for transparency but excluded from clean matched-arm aggregate claims; the driver is fixed for future runs

proposer_failed_outer_jobs.reason: node host-memory OOM before proposal materialization
